## Checklist
> Before submitting a feature or general improvement suggestion, please review the checklist
### I'm sure that...
- [ ] ...I'm using the latest version of Socialismus.
- [ ] ...I have the latest versions of all official modules.
- [ ] ...this isn't a duplicate of an existing suggestion.

## Describe the Improvement
A clear and concise description of the improvement or feature you are suggesting.

## Implementation Details
- **Integration Type**: Should this be a standalone module, a general improvement, or integrated directly into the Socialismus main plugin?
- **Premium Status**: Should this be a premium feature? If so, what would be a fair price for it?
- **Scope and Impact**: How extensive is this improvement? Will it affect multiple areas of the plugin or just a specific function?
- **Dependencies**: Are there any dependencies or prerequisites needed for this improvement to work effectively?

## Expected Benefits
A clear and concise description of the benefits and improvements this feature will bring.

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your suggestion.

## Additional Context
Add any other context or information about the suggestion here.
